item.title: Advancements in SWBLI Characterization and Aerodynamic Modeling for Hypersonic Vehicles
item.description: New research advances our understanding of shock-wave/boundary-layer interactions (SWBLI) for hypersonic vehicles, crucial for accurate CFD modeling and vehicle design.
